title: Yung uno - This Moment
htmlContent:
Yung uno drops a new single called "This Moment". This is the first single of Yung uno EP which he sets to drop soon. "This Moment" describes the deep passion and love for this music. It connects to you and gives you that more we seek when hearing music. This song is beyond words and makes you want to keep running back for this experience of music.

Fast rising hip hop artist Yung uno has been experimenting recently with his sound. The artist has taken pride in never being stuck to one genre, often looking to push his sound further.
